# MS To Do Sync 1.0.6

## 修复
- 修复：`mtd` 机器注释改为写在 Tasks 日期/优先级 emoji 之前，避免破坏 Obsidian Tasks 对截止日期与开始日期的解析；旧版行尾注释会在下次写回时自动迁到正确位置。

## 调整
- 调整：设置「关于 → 文档」链接改为官网教程页 https://obsidian-weave.xyz/#tutorials
- 调整：README 明确 `⏳` / `🛫` 与 Tasks 语义，并说明行内注释落位

# MS To Do Sync 1.0.6

## Fixed
- Fixed: Place `mtd` machine comments before Tasks date/priority emojis so Obsidian Tasks can still parse due/start fields; legacy trailing comments migrate on the next write-back.

## Changed
- Changed: Settings About → Documentation now opens https://obsidian-weave.xyz/#tutorials
- Changed: README clarifies `⏳` / `🛫` vs Tasks semantics and inline comment placement
